## Orientation

Territory: `installer/**`, `orchestra/install.py`, the `install` wiring in `orchestra/cli.py`, `pyproject.toml` only if a new entry point or package data is required, and `tests/test_installer.py`. Do not edit `skills/**`, `shared/**`, `scripts/build_skills.py`, `hosts/**`, `tests/test_skill_portability.py`, `tests/test_cli_packaging.py`, or `tests/integration/test_cli_on_path.py`; earlier waves own those and are done.

Concurrency: this is the only task in wave 2. `native-adapters` will build on your adapter protocol in wave 3, so keep host-specific behavior out of this task and leave a clean adapter interface.

Operational: the worktree is `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/cross-harness-install`. The CLI package from `cli-package` is in place (`pyproject.toml`, `orchestra/cli.py`). Run tests from the worktree. Do not write `.artifacts/`; return evidence and let the parent write the store.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R8: One installer accepts `--only`, `--all`, `--global`, `--copy`, `--dry-run`, and `--uninstall`.
R9: Re-running the installer leaves exactly one registration per selected host.
R14: The installer never copies `.artifacts/`, `.worktrees/`, or dashboard/store state.

## Approach

Add `installer/` with a provider matrix (`providers.toml` or `.json`) and an adapter protocol of `detect/plan/apply/verify/remove`. Wire `orchestra install` with the flags, a plan renderer for `--dry-run`, idempotent apply and remove, and an explicit copy allowlist (`skills/`, `contract/`, `hosts/<host>/`, `agents/`). Add `tests/test_installer.py` covering every flag, dry-run, idempotency, uninstall, and the copy allowlist. Host-specific behavior lands in the next task.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R8: One installer accepts `--only`, `--all`, `--global`, `--copy`, `--dry-run`, and `--uninstall`.
R9: Re-running the installer leaves exactly one registration per selected host.
R14: The installer never copies `.artifacts/`, `.worktrees/`, or dashboard/store state.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Design Invariants:
- Generated reference copies are byte-identical to their source.
- Skills call `orchestra`, `adaptive-artifacts`, and `aff` by name only.
- No adapter copies `.artifacts/`, `.worktrees/`, or dashboard state.
- The installer is idempotent: one registration per host per install scope.
- Store writes stay parent-only; subagents never write records.
- Existing checkout and plugin installs keep working.

Design Assumptions:
- `npx skills add` keeps its `-a <profile>` interface and profile ids.
- Hosts read `SKILL.md` from the paths in the provider matrix.
- `uv` is available wherever the CLI install is documented.
- OpenCode accepts a `skills` config source and `agents/*.md`.
- Claude and Cursor manifest schemas stay compatible.

Decision `installer-native-tail`: choice `native-3-plus-skills-cli`.
